verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence that touches this story is the Call Queues Booster's 'insights' and a per-user Call Log data API. The Call Log API is a developer building block rather than a reporting view, so it earns no credit on its own. That leaves a single vague mention of queue insights. missing for 10: a documented analytics/reporting dashboard, explicit call volume, answer rate and missed-call metrics, per-number and per-teammate breakdowns, independent or hands-on corroboration.
